task_title: Improve sprite taxonomy, judging, and feedback

plan_review.summary: Kept the architecture and incorporated all execution gaps: update duplicate type vocabularies; add equipment/prop defaults; make brief mobRole canonical with issue inference only a hint; add three-quarter facing; use a separate versioned feedback file and POST route; bump judge prompt cache version; migrate existing item-family metadata; inject disliked sprite names into the pure reference selector; and isolate feedback persistence for deterministic tests.
